intro: Specially designed to safeguard your cash, this locker is ideal for both home and office use. It offers quick access exclusively to authorised users and comes equipped with a convenient coin tray.

features.title: Godrej make 6 lever single control key lock
features.text: Experience effortless access with the trusted Godrej 6 Lever Single Control Key Lock. Its precision-built mechanism delivers strong, reliable security while keeping operation simple and intuitive.

features.title: Single plate multi-bend construction
features.text: Built with a single plate and multiple bends, this construction enhances strength and durability. It provides robust resistance against tampering and forced entry.

features.title: Regid Steel lid double bent along its locking edge
features.text: The steel lid is engineered with a double-bent locking edge, providing superior durability and a tight, tamper-resistant seal. Ideal for ensuring the safety and longevity of the contents inside.

features.title: External anchor plates for easy fixing and removal
features.text: These external anchor plates offer secure installation and effortless removal, providing maximum flexibility and ease of use in any setup.

features.title: Tough Metal Build
features.text: Built for superior security, our compact home locker features a tough metal construction that offers unmatched strength and durability. Despite its small size, this sturdy locker provides a reliable and secure storage solution for your valuables, ensuring peace of mind.

features.title: Powder Coated Finish
features.text: The powder-coated finish provides a durable, smooth, and scratch-resistant surface that enhances the longevity and aesthetic appeal of the locker.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. It is Recommended to anchor the Locker with bolts from the bottom as well as the back into a cupboard or onto the wall.
name: Cash Box With Coin Tray Keylock Safe
